correctionToPriorMatrix: The ten-area matrix labelled these eight as effectively distance-only. That described what the v3 writer would receive, not what the Places packs store. This file shows the mapping loss.

mappingLoss.storedAccepted: attributableEntities(Places pack) over SUPPORTED_LOCAL_EVIDENCE_CATEGORIES (healthcare, community, landmarks, transport, schools, retail). These are accepted, attributable Places entities — not editorial facts.
mappingLoss.normalizedAcceptedEntities: buildPharmacyAiLocalCopyInputV1 maps them onto locality.acceptedEntities; buildPharmacyAiLocalCopyInputV3 then filters isCustomerAppropriateOrganisationName.
mappingLoss.v2WouldStillSendNames: usefulLocalEvidenceEntitiesV2 would still send healthcare/community/landmarks/transport names to a v2 writer (dropping schools, retail, and area-named entities).
mappingLoss.serializedToV3Writer: buildAiLocalNarrativeUserPromptV3 serializes only verifiedEditorialFacts (accepted editorial facts with sourceClass primary|secondary, after the organisation-name gate). locality.acceptedEntities are on the input object but are omitted from the prompt JSON.
mappingLoss.sufficiency: assessEditorialSufficiency: “entity names alone are not sufficient”; “Places entity count cannot mark an area ready”.
mappingLoss.collectionGate: collectEditorialEvidenceForArea throws unless the area is in EDITORIAL_PILOT_AREAS (darfield, wombwell, worsbrough only).
mappingLoss.worsbroughHealthcare: repairEditorialPackFromStoredPages: isCustomerAppropriateOrganisationName rejects “The Kakoty Practice Worsbrough Health Centre” (Practice + Health Centre). dumpUrls then rejects the sibling “Worsbrough Health Centre” fact from the same NHS URL.

roleLegend.local introduction: area-identity / borough / settlement paraphrase from an authoritative body
roleLegend.community/history: library activity, heritage group, listed building, mill/park paraphrase from an official source — not a Places name
roleLegend.healthcare context: customer-facing NHS site paraphrase — not a raw Dr-initial Places label
roleLegend.pharmacy relationship/access: in-area premises or verified straight-line km; optionally a paraphrased station/interchange fact
roleLegend.unsuitable/irrelevant: schools, retail, street-junction bus stops, area-named-only entities, raw provider labels, or names that cannot support a patient decision without inventing a route or habit

convenienceLed: Not assigned. The convenience-led template uses prompt/practical/delay language that the writing contract forbids unless an objective supplied fact supports it. None of these eight areas have that fact.
patientJourneyLed: Not assigned as a uniqueness strategy. It is the live ecosystem default and is already a verified duplicate across all ten pages.
